description_en: Queries the tags that are attached to one or more PolarDB clusters, or the PolarDB clusters that are attached to one or more tags
description_zh: 查询一个或多个PolarDB集群已绑定的标签列表，或者查询一个或多个标签绑定的PolarDB集群列表
kebab_example: aliyun polardb list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cluster --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to view the available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to cluster
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义，取值固定为cluster
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A token to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If the first request does not return all results, the response returns a token. You can use this token in the next request to continue the query
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，如果第一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的token继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a cluster. You can specify multiple cluster IDs to query the tags of multiple clusters.

You must specify either the `ResourceId.N` parameter or the `Tag.N.Key` parameter.

If you specify the `ResourceId.N` parameter, you can add up to 50 cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
目标集群ID。若您需要查询多个集群的标签情况，请单击添加来添加目标集群ID。

`ResourceId.N`参数和`Tag.N.Key`参数至少传入一个。
若选择传入`ResourceId.N`参数，则每次最多添加50个集群ID
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The key of a tag. You can specify multiple tags to query for resources that have all of the specified tags.

You must specify either the `ResourceId.N` parameter or the `Tag.N.Key` parameter.

If you specify the `Tag.N.Key` parameter, you can add up to 20 tag pairs
fields.help_zh:
标签键。若您需要查询多个标签下的所有目标集群详情，请单击添加来添加标签。

`ResourceId.N`参数和`Tag.N.Key`参数至少传入一个。
若选择传入`Tag.N.Key`参数，则每次最多添加20对标签
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value that corresponds to the tag key. An empty string is allowed
fields.help_zh: 标签键对应的标签值，允许传入空字符串
fields.name: value

NextToken.description_en: A token to retrieve more results. This parameter is returned if a query does not return all results. You can use the token in a subsequent query to continue retrieving results
NextToken.description_zh: 用来返回更多结果。如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则会返回该参数。您可以在后续查询中传入前一次返回的token继续查询
